original_caption: Visualizing the rank-1 tensor of a neuron. Left: The input phase computes a continuous (infinite-dimensional) scalar landscape g_i(x). Middle: The output phase defines a single, finite-dimensional weight vector w_out,i. Right: The tensor product binds them. The entire function's landscape (represented by the colored points) is mapped along the 1D subspace spanned by w_out,i, which enforces the definition of a rank-1 operator.
